data.text: Each effect you cast becomes a mass effect, affecting all neighboring targets of your choice. Emit-an-element may target tokens/permanents and perform casting at the same time.

logic.description: Implemented permanent. Single: every effect the caster casts becomes a mass effect — target scope hits all adjacent enemies, self / self-or-ally scopes also reach adjacent allies. ∀ double cast: one later cast may be flagged aura and then reaches everyone it concerns within 10 hexes (enemies for hostile scopes, everyone for self scopes), after which the Aura permanent is spent. Placed with a Souls point-buy die as Rule 24 power.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Radius of the mass effect: 1 for the standing Aura, 10 for the one-shot Aura ∀ cast.
Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_souls (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).
